Built-in filter and parameter controls. Filters are tied to one field. Parameters hold a value that calculations read. Tableau lets you change their font, title, background and border, not their shape.

Region ▾
Multiple values (list). Also: Single value (list) = radio buttons.
Hire Type ▾
Single value (dropdown). Multiple values (dropdown) shows checkboxes inside the dropdown.
Hiring Manager ▾
Multiple values (custom list). Use for long lists.
Days to Ready ▾
341
Range of values (slider). Variants: At least / At most / Range of dates.
Start Date ▾
DaysWeeksMonthsQuartersYears
Relative date filter.
Process
Single value (list), horizontal. Closest thing to toggle buttons.
Metric (parameter) ▾
Parameter. Feeds a CASE calc that swaps the measure on a sheet.
Target (parameter)
Type-in parameter. Also: slider parameter, and parameter actions (set by clicking a mark).

Legends

Color legends float or tile on the dashboard; clicking an item highlights (if the highlight button is on). Size and shape legends look the same with a size ramp or the shape glyphs.

Default tooltip: field names regular, values bold. Editable rich text; can embed another sheet ("Viz in Tooltip"). Command buttons can be turned off per sheet.

Dashboard objects

Text object: titles, notes, definitions. Links work on the web only.
Layout: Horizontal / Vertical container, Blank (spacer), Tiled vs Floating. Content: Worksheet, Text, Image, Web Page, Navigation button, Download button (PDF / PPT / PNG / Crosstab), Extension, Pulse metric, Data Story, Ask Data (retired). Device layouts: Desktop / Tablet / Phone.

Font in use on this machine

Categorical palettes (Format › Edit Colors)

Default is Tableau 10, assigned in order. Keep each series the same color on every sheet. Color Blind is the accessible alternative. Tableau 10 fails a color-blind check: red and green (slots 3 and 5) look the same to deuteranopes, and orange, teal, yellow, pink and gray are under 3:1 contrast on white. Label series directly or add a legend, and keep to six categories or fewer.
